defects_found.observed: Stop aborted the run, but the concurrent Continue request surfaced HTTP 500.
defects_found.root_cause: The abort path cancelled the task serving Continue and asyncio.CancelledError escaped through Starlette middleware.
defects_found.resolution: Continue now returns the latest durable run snapshot after cancellation.

defects_found.observed: The launcher required 32 characters while the API and browser accepted 16.
defects_found.root_cause: The minimum was duplicated in three layers.
defects_found.resolution: All layers now use the 32-character contract exposed by the harness configuration.

claim_limits: The test used an isolated fake machine, not the Windows VNC accuracy observer.
The post-fix race was verified at the live HTTP boundary; the initial defect was discovered through the rendered UI.
The web stop path is not independent of the operator web process.
